title: event.bookingAvailability
description:
Indicates whether the event still has tickets or reservations available. Currently contains a `type` that can be `Available` or `Unavailable`.

A `waitingListUrl` is not allowed here: a waiting list is specific to one date, so it can only be set on the [bookingAvailability of a subEvent](./event-subEvent-bookingAvailability.json).
